"Bus permissions"; docs/SIM-PARITY.md): each with why and who fixes it. The simulator still warns of each
missing-permission:<caller>-><service>/<method> (a frame of another app's card: <caller>@<the frame's own app>->...), unknown-method:<service>/<method>, outbound:<caller>-><service>.
tools/gen-bus-permissions.py puts them in the table; remove an entry when its gap is closed.
missing-permission:*->com.palm.service.a: getAccountInfo is only in phoenix.appservices.accounts, the whole accounts service. The connector kit reads each account's info for every sync (apps/shared/connector-kit/src/service.ts:262-265; synckit luna.js accountInfo), and the catalog connectors must not hold the whole service (tools/test-devicecheck.py: their accounts groups); Contacts' contacts UI library asks it too (enyo-1.0 lib/contactsui mojoshim/mojoCore-service.js). On a device the calls are refused (the kit carries on without the account). Owner's decision: a narrow group for it in compat/app-services/com.palm.service.accounts (as phoenix.accounts.list), or the callers stop asking.
missing-permission:org.webosphoenix.serv: The connector kit reads each account's credentials for every sync (apps/shared/connector-kit/src/service.ts:264), but only the drives hold phoenix.accounts.read-credentials (tools/test-devicecheck.py: their accounts groups); on a device the others get no credentials (the kit carries on with {}): a connector keeping its token in the accounts service (Todoist's API token) cannot sync. Owner's decision with the one above.
unknown-method:com.palm.applicationManag: Calendar's dated launcher icon (enyo-1.0 lib, Calendar's app.js): Phoenix's application manager (services/appmanager) has no updateLaunchPointIcon, so on a device the icon keeps its date. Owner: services/appmanager.
unknown-method:com.palm.systemmanager/ap: luna-systemui (a third_party original, SystemManagerService.js) asks luna-sysmgr's systemmanager; Phoenix's (services/systemmanager) does not have it. Device audit, row C5 (as check-luna's luna:unknown-method:com.palm.systemmanager/*).
unknown-method:com.palm.systemmanager/ge: As applicationHasBeenTerminated: luna-systemui's, not in services/systemmanager. Row C5.

unknown-method:com.palm.systemmanager/su: As applicationHasBeenTerminated: luna-systemui's, not in services/systemmanager. Row C5.
unknown-method:com.palm.systemmanager/ge: Settings > Developer's overlays: not in services/systemmanager (check-luna allowlist, row C5).
unknown-method:com.palm.systemmanager/ta: The Assistant's screenshot: not in services/systemmanager (check-luna allowlist, row C5).
unknown-method:com.webos.service.downloa: OSE's luna-downloadmgr (not ours) has no filesysStatusCheck, so luna-systemui's low-storage alerts never fire on a device (check-luna allowlist, row C5).
unknown-method:com.webos.service.activit: OSE's activitymanager (not ours) has getActivityInfo, not webOS's getDetails; Podcasts' and Tasks' scheduled work falls back to create when it fails (check-luna allowlist, row C5).
unknown-method:com.webos.service.systems: OSE's systemservice has no ringtone category; Settings' and Contacts' ringtone pickers (check-luna allowlist, row C5).
unknown-method:com.webos.applicationMana: OSE's SAM has no open; the apps' openers (Files, Scanner, Terminal, the Marketplace) go to com.palm.applicationManager on a device only through @phoenix/luna's fallback (check-luna allowlist, row C5).
OSE's SAM has no handlers (check-luna allowlist, row C5).
unknown-method:org.webosphoenix.transcri: Voice Memos' dictation: the transcriber has no listen yet (check-luna allowlist, row C5: keyboard agent, dictation V5).
missing-permission:*@org.webosphoenix.sh: The share sheet and file picker (apps/sharesheet) are a frame of the asking app's card, on a device too (runtime/phoenix-runtime.js shareSheet()), so what they list (the file manager, the media indexer, the system manager's status) is asked as the asking app, and few apps hold filemanager.operation, mediaindexer.operation and systemmanager.query. On a device the sheet comes up empty in those apps. Owner's decision: those groups for every app that shares or picks, or the sheet in a card of its own.
unknown-method:com.palm.systemmanager/pu: The backup service tells luna-systemui of a failed backup through luna-sysmgr's publishToSystemUI (apps/settings/service/backupservice.js); Phoenix's systemmanager (services/systemmanager) does not have it, so on a device the Backup Failure event never reaches the system UI (check-luna allowlist, row C5).
unknown-method:com.palm.systemmanager/en: Settings > Developer > Debugging's touch plot: luna-sysmgr's, not in services/systemmanager (check-luna allowlist, row C5).
Settings > Developer > Debugging's frame counter: luna-sysmgr's, not in services/systemmanager (check-luna allowlist, row C5).
missing-permission:org.webosphoenix.mess: Messaging tells a messaging connector a conversation was read (markRead), but each connector gives markRead only to its own account group (telegram.account, matrix.account, xmpp.account, deltachat.account), which Messaging does not hold; on a device the read state never reaches the service. Owner's decision: a shared group for the transports' Messaging-facing methods (as accounts.transport is for the accounts service), or Messaging holds each connector's.
